**Patient:** Sarah

**Date:** October 26, 2023

**HPI:** Patient presents with significant pain and limited range of motion in the right knee following a recent diagnosis of severe Tricompartmental Osteoarthritis.  Reports persistent clicking and locking sensations.  History reveals history of osteoarthritis prior to this episode.  Patient is considering total knee arthroplasty as a potential treatment option.

**Physical Exam:**  Range of motion limited, with pain exacerbated by flexion and extension.  Tenderness palpable over the medial joint line.  Neurological examination unremarkable.  Palpable osteophytes noted.
